visibleLines: Harbor. Every autumn the ferry crews repaint the harbor signs before the storms reach our northern pier while the gulls
complain about the noise all afternoon long and the old lighthouse keeper counts the coils of rope stacked beside the slipway and
writes the tally into a damp ledger that nobody ever reads because the weather has already decided how the season will turn out
